options.thread_timeline: The thread is the interface: one line across the screen is time. Past release days are beads (size = how much you moved, filled = protection would have paid). Atty stands at today. Upcoming releases are knots ahead of her, tied (protect) or cut (skip). Clicking a knot plays her walkthrough for that release; settled calls slide into the past showing whether she was right.
options.story_mode: Full-screen story mode only: one sentence and one visual per screen, tap to advance, like phone stories; detail tables behind a single "see everything" link.
options.chat_first: Chat first: the user talks to Atty (voice or text) and she answers with small cards for quotes, history and fine print.
options.current: Keep the current page: a walkthrough hero beside Atty, then numbered index sections (quotes, public funds, watching, news).
